feature: The 1-byte 'char' type (OID 18) cannot be disambiguated from bpchar because the parser folds both to the same internal representation
resume_point: Modify parser to distinguish literal 'char' from bpchar during type parsing

feature: ALTER TABLE … ALTER COLUMN RESET (…) is not implemented and is treated as a no-op; per-column options can be set but not cleared
Per-column n_distinct planner hints are stored in attoptions for dump compatibility but are not used by the query planner for optimization
SET STATISTICS column option is only supported in ALTER TABLE but not in CREATE TABLE; statistics targets cannot be specified when creating a table
TOAST compression functionality is not implemented. Compression metadata round-trips through pg_dump for schema fidelity, but actual data compression is not performed.
Autovacuum functionality is not implemented; autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor values are stored and dumped for compatibility but do not trigger automatic vacuuming
COLLATE and USING clauses in ALTER TYPE … ALTER ATTRIBUTE are accepted by the parser but their effects are ignored during execution
Persistent storage of server definitions (currently in-memory only)

Typed table support for composite types in non-public schemas
VIEW WITH CHECK OPTION is not enforced on INSERT/UPDATE operations; WITH (check_option=...) reloption form is parsed but ignored; restart persistence is in-memory only, not persisted.
